definition.duplicate: duplicate excess row; repeated trip_id beyond the first row
definition.malformed_date: tpep_pickup_datetime cannot parse as yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
definition.missing_location: PULocationID is null OR DOLocationID is null

sampling.allocation: Hamilton largest remainder; ties by ascending pickup hour
sampling.position_digest_encoding: source-order zero-based row positions as unsigned 64-bit big-endian integers
sampling.eligibility: non-null pickup/dropoff, finite non-null locations, finite fare > 0; pickup inside source month when inferred
